collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: Two villagers resting in the grass have been watching cloud shapes far too long: keep watching, or get back to work.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) are lying on their backs in the grass, supposed to be resting for five minutes. It has been much more than five minutes. They're looking at the clouds. "That one's a turtle," says (subject). "That's a fish wearing a hat," says (friend). Work is waiting. Neither of them moves.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They keep finding shapes. A canoe. A dog chasing its tail. A face that looks exactly like one of the elders, which makes them both laugh until they cry. The afternoon slips away. Nobody comes looking for them. When they finally get up, they have done no work and seen eleven animals, three boats and an elder.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Right," says (subject), sitting up. "Work." They go back to work. But all afternoon (subject) keeps glancing up at the sky, and so does (friend). Whenever their eyes meet, one of them points up and mouths a shape. The work gets done. It takes twice as long. It's much more fun.
